text: SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS CHEMBL_ID, m.pref_name AS preferred_name, m.max_phase AS maximum_phase, m.molecule_type AS molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles AS SMILES FROM molecule_dictionary m INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON m.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133022';
